y-m-09-07.goal: Ziva kuti kana huwandu hwetebhura husiyana nehuwandu hwevanhu vakaongororwa, haufaniri kumanikidza nhamba kuti dzienderane asi utarise nedata yekutanga, uye gadzira iwe pachako matebhura akati wandei akagadziriswa anogutsa mamiriro kuti usimbise kuti hapana rimwe chete.
y-m-09-07.material:
Kirasi 2 yeGrade 3 ine vadzidzi 28 zvose, uye mudzidzi wega wega akavhota kamwe chete. Mumwe nemumwe akasarudza mutambo mumwe wavanofarira kuvhotera, uye Harin akarongera mhedzisiro mutebhura.
Dodgeball vadzidzi 10 / Kudhonza tambo vadzidzi 8 / Tag vadzidzi 7 / Board games vadzidzi 6
Tarisa tsananguro yaHarin.
y-m-09-07.thinking.2: Kugadzira matebhura akati wandei akagadziriswa anogoneka mukati memamiriro
y-m-09-07.prereq.0: Kuverenga huwandu hwevadzidzi hwechinhu chimwe nechimwe kubva patebhura uye kuwana huwandu hwose (Grade 3 level)
y-m-09-07.prereq.1: Kuziva chibvumirano che survey chekuti munhu wega wega anoverengwa kamwe chete
y-m-09-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe usina kururama mutsananguro yaHarin. (Kana mitsetse miviri isina kururama, unogona kusarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama.)
y-m-09-07.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nhamba mbiri kubva pamutsetse 1 nemutsetse 2 padivi pedivi uye uwane kwadzisina kuenderana.
y-m-09-07.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe, tsanangura kuti nhamba yakabva papi munhamba dzemutsetse wapfuura, uye kana zvinotaurwa nemutsetse i chokwadi chakasimbiswa kare.
y-m-09-07.s.s1.line.0: Kirasi ine vadzidzi 28, uye mumwe nemumwe akavhota kamwe chete.
y-m-09-07.s.s1.line.1: Kuwedzera nhamba dzose dzevadzidzi mutebhura kunopa 10+8+7+6=31.
y-m-09-07.s.s1.line.2: Vanhu 31 vakavhota, saka kirasi yakawedzera ne vadzidzi 3.
y-m-09-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 hauna kururama. Mutsetse 1 wakati kirasi ine vadzidzi 28 uye mumwe nemumwe akavhota kamwe chete, saka kana huwandu hwose i 31, i chiratidzo chekuti pane dambudziko netebhura kana maitiro e survey. Wakataura kuti vadzidzi vakawedzera pasina kutarisa nei huwandu hwose hwakasiyana. Mutsetse 4 unotevera uye usinawo kururama. Huwandu hwose 31 mumutsetse 2 hwakaverengwa zvakarurama.
y-m-09-07.s.s2.prompt: Kuziva nei huwandu hwose hwakava 31, chii chakanaka kuita pakutanga?
y-m-09-07.s.s2.hint.0: Pakati pesarudzo, siyanisa nzira dzinochinja "zvokwadi zvaunoziva zvino" nenzira dzinotarisa "zvokwadi zvakare."
y-m-09-07.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana unogona kuziva kuti mutambo upi usina kururama kana ukashandisa nzira inogadzirisa huwandu hwose chete.
y-m-09-07.s.s2.o.a: Verenga zvakare mapepa evhoti emutambo mumwe nemumwe uye uaenzanise rimwe nerimwe nenhamba dziri mutebhura
y-m-09-07.s.s2.r.a: Pfungwa iyi inowana kwazvisina kuenderana nekutarisa tebhura zvakananga nedata yekutanga.
y-m-09-07.s.s2.o.b: Chinja nhamba hombe zvikuru, 10, kuita 7 kuti huwandu hwose huve 28
y-m-09-07.s.s2.r.b: Kana ukangoita kuti huwandu hwose huenderane pasina kutarisa chikonzero, haugone kuziva kuti mutambo upi wakanganisa.

y-m-09-07.s.s2.r.c: Pfungwa iyi inoedza kuwana mazita anopindirana uye kusimbisa chikonzero.
y-m-09-07.s.s2.r.d: Kuti kune vadzidzi 28 i chokwadi chakasimbiswa. Uri kuchinja chokwadi chakasimbiswa kuti chienderane netebhura.
y-m-09-07.s.s2.explain: Kana huwandu hwose husingaenderani, usagadzirise nhamba pakutanga; unofanira kutarisa tebhura nedata yekutanga. Kana ukaverenga zvakare mapepa kana ukatarisa mazita anopindirana, unogona kuwana kwakaverengwa vadzidzi 3 vakawandisa.

y-m-09-01.title: Angle ine mativi marefu iangle huru here?
y-m-09-01.goal: Dzidza kuti hukuru hweangle hahusarudzwi nekureba kwemativi asi nekuti mativi maviri anovhurika kusvika kupi, uchiongorora nenzira umo humbowo hwekufananidza nepepa reright-angle hunovakwa, uye ugadzirise kutonga kwako kwekutanga.
y-m-09-01.material: Mina akadhirowa maangles maviri. Angle ㄱ ine mativi maviri e3 cm imwe neimwe anobuda pavertex, uye angle ㄴ ine mativi maviri e6 cm imwe neimwe. Mina anoti, "Angle ㄴ ine mativi marefu, saka iangle huru." Hapana mufananidzo. Pane pepa rakapetwa muchimiro cheright-angle (pepa reright-angle). Pepa iri chishandiso: unoenzanisa kona yaro nevertex yeangle, unoisa divi rimwe pamusoro payo, wobva wataridza kuti divi rimwe reangle rinorara sei pamusoro pedivi repepa. (ㄱ inoverengwa giyeok, ㄴ inoverengwa nieun, ㄷ inoverengwa digeut, uye ㄹ inoverengwa rieul.)
y-m-09-01.thinking.2: Kutsvaga nyaya apo maangles akafanana kunyange kureba kwakasiyana, uye akasiyana kunyange kureba kwakafanana
y-m-09-01.prereq.0: Kuratidza vertex nemativi maviri eangle (chiyero cheGrade 3, semester yekutanga)
y-m-09-01.prereq.1: Kuisa pepa reright-angle paangle kusiyanisa right angles, maangles makuru kupfuura right angle, nemaangles madiki
y-m-09-01.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza pfungwa yako yekuti angle ipi huru.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora padivi nedivi kureba kwemativi eangle ㄱ neangle ㄴ, uye unyore kuti ruzivo rupi rumwe kunze kwekureba rwaunoda kuti ugone kufananidza.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kana uchiisa pepa reright-angle paangle, ita neruoko kuti divi repepa nedivi rimwe reangle zvinorara sei.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Zvinozikanwa: Mativi maviri eangle ㄱ i3 cm imwe neimwe, uye mativi maviri eangle ㄴ i6 cm imwe neimwe. Hatisati taziva kuti maangles maviri akavhurika kusvika kupi.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Neizvi zvaunoziva zvino chete, unogona kutaura kuti angle ipi huru here?
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Haugoni kufananidza hukuru hwemaangles maviri nekureba kwemativi oga. Unoda imwe nzira yekubata maangles maviri pamuyero mumwe chete.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Angle ㄴ huru, nokuti mativi ayo marefu.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kana mativi akareba, angle inoita seyakakura nyore. Funga kana kureba kwemativi kuchikuudza kuti angle yakavhurika kusvika kupi.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Angle ㄱ huru. Mativi kana ari mapfupi, inokombama zvakawanda.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Mativi kuva mapfupi hazvireve kuti inokombama zvakawanda. Zvakafanana nemativi kuva marefu.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Maangles maviri akafanana, nokuti imwe neimwe ine mativi maviri.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Angle imwe neimwe ine mativi maviri. Chokwadi ichi choga hachikubvumiri kufananidza hukuru.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hatigoni kusarudza zvino. Hatizivi kuti maangles maviri akavhurika zvakapamhama zvakadii.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Pfungwa iyi inotora kureba kwemativi nekuvhurika kweangle sezvikamu zveruzivo zvakasiyana.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Pandakaenzanisa kona yepepa reright-angle nevertex yeangle ㄱ ndokuisa divi rimwe pamusoro payo, divi rimwe reangle ㄱ rakakodzera zvakakwana nedivi rimwe repepa. Ndakaita zvakafanana kuangle ㄴ, uye yakakodzerawo zvakakwana.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ungafananidza sei maangles maviri neruzivo rutsva urwu?
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Kunyange kureba kwemativi kwakasiyana, 3 cm ne6 cm, maangles maviri aiva nehukuru hwakafanana (right angle). Pfungwa yekutanga "mativi marefu anoreva angle huru" haikodzeri humbowo uhu.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Angle ㄴ huru. Mativi ayo i6 cm, saka inovhara pepa rakawanda.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Unofanira kufananidza nzira umo mativi anorara, kwete nzvimbo yainovhara papepa. Verenga zvakare chiitiko che "yakakodzera zvakakwana."
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Angle ㄱ huru. Mativi mapfupi anokodzera pepa zvirinani.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Zvakacherekedzwa hazvisi "zvinokodzera zvirinani" asi "dzose dzakakodzera zvakakwana."
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Maangles maviri ane hukuru hwakafanana. Dzose dziri right angles.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kufunga uku kunofananidza zvichibva pamhedzisiro yekudzibata pamuyero mumwe chete (pepa reright-angle).
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Hatigoni kusarudza zvino. Tinofanira kuita mativi marefu wobva waongorora zvakare.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kunyange ukaita mativi marefu, nzira yaanorara haichinji. Funga kana chiitiko chawatoita chakakwana.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ndakadhirowawo angle ㄷ neangle ㄹ. Mativi eangles ose maviri i2 cm imwe neimwe. Pandakaisa pepa reright-angle, divi rimwe reangle ㄷ rakanga riri mukati medivi repepa, uye divi rimwe reangle ㄹ rakanga riri kunze kwedivi repepa.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Pakati peangle ㄱ, angle ㄷ, neangle ㄹ, ndeipi iangle huru zvikuru?
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Maangles maviri ane kureba kwemativi kwakafanana kwe2 cm (ㄷ neㄹ) aivawo nehukuru hwakasiyana. Kune maangles akafanana kunyange kureba kwakasiyana uye maangles akasiyana kunyange kureba kwakafanana, saka hukuru hweangle hahusarudzwi nekureba kwemativi.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Angle ㄷ. Iri mukati memativi epepa, saka inovhurika zvakapamhama.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tarisa nekubata pepa kuti "mukati" zvinoreva kuti inovhurika zvakawanda kana zvishoma.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Angle ㄹ. Inovhurika kunze kwemativi epepa.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Pfungwa iyi yakafananidza angle inovhurika kunze kwemativi epepa reright-angle neright angle.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Hatigoni kuziva. Mativi emaangles matatu haana kureba kwakafanana ose.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kunyange mativi asina kureba kwakafanana, unogona kufananidza uchishandisa mhedzisiro yekubata pepa reright-angle.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Angle ㄱ. Divi rayo rakareba zvikuru pa3 cm.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ruzivo rutsva munhanho iyi harusi kureba kwemativi asi mhedzisiro yekubata pepa.
y-m-09-01.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, kunonotsera kutonga kwaikodzera nokuti taiziva kureba kwemativi chete. Patakaabata pamuyero mumwe chete, pepa reright-angle, paiva nemaangles akafanana kunyange kureba kwemativi kwakasiyana (ㄱ neㄴ), nemaangles akasiyana kunyange kureba kwemativi kwakafanana (ㄷ neㄹ). Taura kuti ruzivo rupi panhanho ipi rwakachinja kufunga kwako.
y-m-09-01.s.s2.prompt: Maoko eawa remawachi ane kureba kwakasiyana. Pakati peawa apo minute hand inongedza ku12, tsvaga nguva mbiri dzakasiyana apo maoko maviri anogadzira right angle. (Nyora kuti ndeawa ripi, kubva pa1 o'clock kusvika pa12 o'clock.)

y-m-09-04.title: Kufungidzira huremu hweapuro imwe nechiyero chebhalansi

Waisa apuro pambiya imwe yechiyero chebhalansi uye zviyero pambiya imwe kuti uenzanise. Divi rinorema rinodzika, uye kana zviyero zvakaenzana, chiyero chinenge chakaenzana. Kucherechedza 1: apuro 1 vs. zviyero zvaviri zve 200 g → divi reapuro rakadzika.
